decision.compressionCandidate: lossless encodings only; actual CDN encoding/cost unknown, no deployment or user LCP benefit claimed
decision.domCandidate: compression leaves DOM unchanged; editorial chapter split requires separate author brief and URL/anchor preservation, no client-side hiding
decision.nextStep: track raw HTML/compressed bytes/prose nodes separately; test chapter allocation with full SSR and canonical/legacy anchor coverage before production

limitations: Three HTML inputs are selected accepted reference pages, not a site-wide percentile.
Encoding costs are one local process measurement, not user latency or stable CPU estimates.
Original source spans are counted in UTF-8 bytes; text character count uses JS UTF-16 length.

DOM counts are parse5 static element nodes with scripting enabled, not browser runtime DOM; older parser counts are not silently compared. Node zlib bytes are not assumed equal to prior Python gzip or live wire encoding.
Desktop/mobile TOC markup counts are disjoint from prose; responsive hidden markup still counts as parsed DOM, not asserted active layout cost.
